name: Twelve at Hengshan
insider_take: This Art Deco masterpiece seamlessly blends Shanghai's golden-age glamour with contemporary luxury in the heart of the former French Concession.
whats_special: Originally built in 1934, this historic building was once home to Shanghai's elite and later served as a diplomatic residence. The hotel preserves original architectural details like terrazzo floors and wrought-iron balconies while offering modern amenities. Located on prestigious Hengshan Road, it sits amid tree-lined streets filled with European-style villas and boutiques.
pro_tip: Book a Heritage Suite to experience the building's original layout with high ceilings and period details, plus enjoy exclusive Marriott STARS benefits including room upgrades and daily breakfast.
dont_miss: Take an evening stroll through the surrounding Former French Concession neighborhood to discover hidden speakeasies, vintage shopping on Fuxing Road, and the nearby Xujiahui Park. The hotel's rooftop terrace offers stunning views of Shanghai's evolving skyline.
pros: Prime location in Shanghai's prestigious Hengshan Road area
Elegant Art Deco design with sophisticated contemporary touches
Exceptional dining experiences with rooftop restaurant
Marriott STARS program benefits and luxury amenities
cons: Boutique property with limited room inventory
Premium pricing typical of luxury Shanghai hotels
